Okay?”

fics.title: Alien dinner
fics.author: Grays_Lament
fics.summary: Peter was born on earth, a small Terran boy who only got to spend 8 of his years learning the ways of his ancestors. In those years he learned two things. One, he wasn't human he was a ghoul. Two, cassette players are awesome, also outlaws are badass (but that's beside the point). When he was abducted by an actual intergalactic space ship ran by outlaws he learned another two things. One, When aliens threaten to eat you they're not being serious and you shouldn't eat them in retaliation. Two, being a ravager, outlaw, half-ghoul that travels space in search of treasure, women, and the finest of alien meats is considerably better than any outlaw he could imagine on earth. - Or, Peter Quill is a half-ghoul half-god in space. Hijinx and angst happen.

fics.title: mess is mine
fics.author: godblessgamora
fics.summary: He bites the inside of his cheek, almost like he’s debating something. “Gamora…” She steps around him without another word. “I begged to work with you.” His voice is urgent. Practically desperate. And it's that, together with the actual words, that strucks her to her core. A shiver of something dances up her spine. She slowly turns around. “What?” He pinches the bridge of his nose, looking embarrassed and defeated. He mutters under his nose, “This is not how… Dammit.”

fics.title: A Memory Like Home
fics.author: evasmlp
fics.summary: After months on Earth, Peter Quill is startled to see a familiar silhouette at the end of his driveway. As Gamora steps into the light, memories in her eyes, she closes the distance without a word. She runs into his arms, and their long lost love reignites with an unrestrained kiss. Peter Quill had learned a few things about Earth since he came back.

fics.title: The strange man of Knowhere
fics.author: Anonymous
fics.summary: Peter is acting strange. Gamora is worried, and the Avengers are both confused and shocked. When they reached Knowhere his instincts were screaming at him that something wasn’t right. It was too quiet and he felt more on edge than usual. He noticed Gamora watching him and he ignored it. He had a feeling she’d noticed something was off about him. He wasn’t sure what it was, but something inside of him had shifted recently and even though he tried to push it down and ignore it. Whatever it was wanted out and he was scared to know what that meant.
